_schema: gamebundle v1. all entity tables are {ids, rows/tags/sets}; cross-references are INTEGER INDICES into the named vocab. typechart: flat row-major over types[], damage multiplier x4 (0=immune,1=0.25x,2=0.5x,4=1x,8=2x,16=4x). move rows: [type, category, power, accuracy, pp, priority, target]. species rows: [type1, type2(-1 pad), hp, atk, def, spa, spd, spe, ability0, ability1, abilityH(-1 pad)]. set rows: [role, [moveIdx], [abilityIdx], [teraTypeIdx], [evs x6]].
